note: Reference port for Strategy A: one compat header (src/colmap/util/cuda_to_hip.h), .cu sources marked LANGUAGE HIP. ROCm/HIP support for patch_match_stereo landed upstream via community PR colmap/colmap#4420 (author iShengnan; jeff contributed directly), squash-merged 2026-08-05 as b09267a21. Two CUDA-only gaps remain upstream: GPU SIFT (src/thirdparty/SiftGPU, gated `if(CUDA_ENABLED)`) and CASPAR bundle adjustment (src/thirdparty/Symforce-Caspar, `CASPAR_ENABLED AND NOT CUDA_ENABLED` is a hard FATAL_ERROR). The parked SIFT work is on jeffdaily/colmap:rocm-sift-gpu @ e41e06e0b (2026-05-26), NOT on the AMD-Ecosystem fork, which was created 2026-08-05 and carries only upstream branches. That work must be RE-DERIVED on top of the squash rather than rebased: its first four commits are inside b09267a21 and the PR then continued for five more commits the branch does not have. The three SIFT commits (bf064e920, e95eb3806, 3345a9819) touch files #4420 never modified; the gpu_mat_test/version-banner (690348f33) and docs (566e4df7e, e41e06e0b) commits are likely superseded and must be checked against upstream before re-applying.
